body: Gold bar BCD+AIDC: 15% until 23-Jul-2024; 6% (5+1) from 24-Jul-2024 via 30/2024+32/2024-Customs (primary); no change in Budget 2025-26 (primary memo); Budget 2026-27 kept 6% (02/2026-Customs only adds 31-Mar-2027 sunset to S.No.192-195; primary). 15% (10+5) from 13-May-2026 via 15/2026+16/2026-Customs per Antigravity search; notification text NOT yet seen; market gap IBJA vs spot ~16% Nov-2026 consistent. Antigravity's earlier 'Feb-2026 cut to 5%' was wrong.
title: India gold customs duty timeline Jul-2024..Nov-2026
